scope: Read-only source overlap and VOP gate audit. No dictionary shards were modified.

sources.current_corpus: Lexi data/*.json (Wiktionary-derived, 81,068 headwords, 133,763 senses in shards; meta.source_senses is 133,646 because it excludes 117 curated senses)

dicionario_aberto.name: Dicionário Aberto
dicionario_aberto.basis: Novo Diccionário da Língua Portuguesa, Cândido de Figueiredo, 1913
dicionario_aberto.note: Historical PT-PT dictionary, not a modern PT-PT source.

vop.name: Vocabulário Ortográfico do Português
vop.access: Public exact search and lemma pages; queries made one form at a time.
vop.note: Spelling/morphological vocabulary. Regional labels appear on some lemmas (Brasil/Portugal); most lexical items are unmarked.

vop_gate.method: Exact VOP search for each form, then the lemma page region label. PASS = replacement is PT/UNMARKED and original is BR/NOT_FOUND. AMBIGUOUS = both forms are PT/UNMARKED. VOP does not measure usage frequency or preferred lexical choice.

recommendations: Apply only the 12 VOP-confirmed orthographic rules as suggestions, preserving the original text and marking them unreviewed. They cover 1,227 unmarked senses (1,259 occurrences) after quoted text is excluded.
Do not auto-apply the ambiguous orthographic rules (registro, fôrma, planejado: 83 senses). VOP has both forms as valid and the choice is semantic/usage-dependent.

Do not treat the lexical VOP results as validation. VOP leaves suco, geladeira, celular, tela, banheiro, xícara, sorvete, abacaxi, biscoito, camisa, torcida, arquivo, time and trem unmarked. Lexical conversion needs sense-level context rules or editorial review.

Add Dicionário Aberto only as a separate, clearly labelled historical PT-PT layer. It overlaps 37,671 current headwords (46.5% raw; 54.0% of single-word headwords) but is a 1913 dictionary and cannot replace modern definitions.
Do not merge the 88,754 Dicionário Aberto-only forms wholesale. 22,123 (24.6%) contain old-orthography markers; the rest include rare/archaic variants and proper names.
Keep the 57-term regional table. 49 PT forms exist in VOP; the 8 multiword forms (casa de banho, paragem de autocarro, etc.) are outside VOP scope, not invalid.
For modern PT-PT definitions at scale, license a modern dictionary (DLPC, Priberam, Infopédia) or expand the curated editorial layer. No open drop-in PT-PT dictionary replacement was found.
limits: Headword comparison is case- and accent-insensitive; it does not align senses or meanings.
Dicionário Aberto is a 1913 work with historical orthography and semantics.
VOP is a spelling vocabulary, not a frequency or usage corpus. An unmarked form may be valid in Portugal and Brazil, or simply listed without a regional label.
Candidate counts are occurrences in unmarked senses, not reviewed conversions. Quoted text was excluded from the quoted counts but proper nouns and examples were not separately removed.
No app runtime, data shards, service worker or version were changed by this audit.
